sources.title: System Reference Document 5.2.1
sources.section: Playing the Game: D20 Tests, Ability Checks, Saving Throws, Advantage/Disadvantage, and Proficiency

rules.name: D20 Test
rules.beginner_description: Roll a d20, add the relevant canonical modifiers, and succeed when the total equals or exceeds the target number.

rules.name: Ability Check
rules.beginner_description: An ability check tests talent and training against a challenge; the GM selects the relevant ability and any applicable skill or tool.

rules.name: Saving Throw
rules.beginner_description: A saving throw uses the ability named by the threat and adds Proficiency Bonus only when the character is proficient in that save.

rules.name: Difficulty Class
rules.beginner_description: An ability check or saving throw succeeds when its total equals or exceeds the Difficulty Class set by the rule or GM.

rules.name: Advantage
rules.beginner_description: Roll two d20s and use the higher result; multiple Advantage sources still produce only two dice.

rules.name: Disadvantage
rules.beginner_description: Roll two d20s and use the lower result; any Advantage and any Disadvantage cancel so only one d20 is rolled.
